6.117 rsMapLayerMissingProperty
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsMapLayerMissingProperty is a critical error that will occur when a required element in MapLineLayer,
MapPointLayer, or MapPolygonLayer is missing.
